summary: Push A day. No wellness-bar protein smoothie on today's menu, so pre-workout leans on an Evolve shake plus a half bagel and banana. Lunch brings in chicken enchiladas and dinner brings in gochujang cod, both new mains for variety after recent soy sauce chicken and salmon days.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Oats, eggs and turkey for protein, sourdough and banana for carbs.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Chicken enchiladas as the main for variety, extra chicken breast and wild rice round out protein and carbs.

items.name: Chicken Enchiladas, Cotija Cheese, Cilantro, Crema

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: Evolve shake (no wellness smoothie today), half a bagel and a banana.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Gochujang cod (new main) for protein-source variety, extra chicken breast, avocado and sweet potato close out protein, fat and carbs.
